english:
Readying a Heat Weapon, Submachine Gun, or Hand Cannon grants 'Reflex Action' for 1.5 seconds, providing:
• 40% decreased Ready/Stow Animation Duration
• 10% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 10% decreased <title Accuracy Cone Growth [G_conegrowth] />

Dealing additional Weapon Damage refreshes the buff duration.

2 Piece | Reflex Action

Upon readying a Heat Weapon, Submachine Gun, or Hand Cannon:
Grants Reflex Action for 1.5 seconds.
 Dealing Additional Weapon Damage refreshes the buff duration.

Reflex Action | 0.6x Ready/Stow Duration Multiplier, -10% Accuracy Cone Size, -10% Accuracy Cone Growth for 1.5 seconds.
